summary: Claude for Startups lets founders apply for free Claude API credits and priority rate limits. The program is open to early-stage founders with or without VC backing, but credits require equity funding from an institutional investor, a company founded within the last four years, and no prior Anthropic startup credits. You need a Claude Console account (API console, not the Claude app) and a company email. Credits apply only to the first-party Claude API, not AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI. Anthropic does not publish a dollar amount for the credit grant.
claim_steps: Create a Claude Console account (API console, not claude.ai) with a company email.
To qualify for credits: institutional equity funding, founded within 4 years, no prior Anthropic startup credits. Mention a partner VC if you have one.
If accepted, credits and highest rate limits apply to the first-party Claude API only (not Bedrock or Vertex AI).
